in_marathi.name: Agniprava
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agniprava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Agni is the god of fire. Prava means desire or longing. So, Agniprava can be interpreted as 'desire for fire' or 'fire's desire'. This name is often given to children born during the Agni Nakshatra.

in_bengali.name: Agniprava
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Fire's Desire
in_bengali.long_meaning: Agniprava একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Agni is the god of fire. Prava means desire or longing. So, Agniprava can be interpreted as 'desire for fire' or 'fire's desire'. This name is often given to children born during the Agni Nakshatra.
